on_screen_text.text: Sen. Warren breaks down why Trump is going after Fed Chair Powell
SEN. WARREN ADDRESSES PROBE INTO FED CHAIR POWELL

spoken_summary: Elizabeth Warren explains that Donald Trump is relentlessly pursuing Federal Reserve Chair Powell because the Fed's independence is a 'challenge' to someone like Trump 'who thinks he's supposed to run everything.' She accuses Trump of 'weaponizing the Department of Justice right out in plain view' in an attempt to take over the Fed and make political decisions that will help him in the 2026 election.
audio_music: The audio consists solely of Elizabeth Warren's speaking voice, without any background music or sound effects. It has the clear, direct sound of a news broadcast clip.
editing_pacing: The video is a single, static shot of a talking head (Elizabeth Warren). The only visual elements are the pre-existing news broadcast graphics and added overlay text.
central_claim: Donald Trump is weaponizing the Department of Justice to gain control of the Federal Reserve for his own political benefit ahead of the 2026 election.
intended_effect: To persuade the viewer that Donald Trump poses a threat to the independence of key governmental institutions.
